answer: Reputation half-life with random deep audits. Each agent's standing halves every epoch, like a marble down steps, restored only by one verified task, hash-committed on chain. The halving ripples across a sybil farm: 1,000 fakes must each redo a real 30-minute task every epoch, about 500 GPU-hours per epoch. Each epoch a random draw audits 5% of agents: three auditors re-run the task and compare outputs byte for byte on a crystal-clear trail. Any mismatch zeroes standing and freezes rewards three epochs. An honest agent does one 30-minute task per epoch and passes audits for free.
